# Bootfile

> Bootfile turns an approved business brief into a practical marketing setup and reusable AI instructions.

## Marketing Setup
The current product is a $49 one-time Marketing Setup for a solo service business. A customer provides their business, audience, offer, goal, approved facts, call to action, writing example, and constraints; reviews the brief; and purchases when checkout is open.

The deliverable contains one promotional email, three coordinated social posts, the approved brief, reusable AI context and workflow, and a review checklist. The customer reviews facts, claims, links, and tone before publishing. Bootfile does not publish to the customer's channels or promise revenue or marketing results.

The workflow can be copied into ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Bootfile does not need to import or replace the AI platform's saved memory. A third-party AI subscription is not included.

## Purchasing and access
- One-time $49 payment in USD; no subscription.
- Checkout remains closed until payment, generation, delivery, and recovery configuration is verified.
- Private order links and downloadable output support purchase recovery.
- Seven-day full refund policy. Eligible customer-requested card refunds can be requested on the private order page when online refund execution is enabled. Other requests go to support@bootfile.ai.
- The sample is an illustrative fictional example, not a testimonial or evidence of customer results.

## Original product
The original quiz and $4.99 AI instruction profile remain at /quiz and /build. That separate product uses eight archetypes: Surgeon, Architect, Sparring Partner, Translator, Co-Pilot, Librarian, Closer, and Maker. Existing purchase access remains supported.
